name: A100-80GB SXM Llama-3-8B Q4_K_M decode (RunPod measured)
methodology: XiongjieDai GPU-Benchmarks-on-LLM-Inference, llama.cpp on RunPod, Q4_K_M GGUF, batch-1 decode
notes: Closest measured sibling for the A100 40GB SXM4 record. 80GB part has ~2,039 GB/s vs the 40GB's ~1,555 GB/s (~24% less BW) - scale 8B decode down to ~100-110 tok/s for the 40GB part. Used as the calibration point for the A100-40GB SXM4 row in the used-datacenter ingest.
